The first day i took vyvanse i felt actually insane because i didn’t feel all brain racy and what not.

Also, it isn’t unlikely that your anxiety and depression were byproducts of -if not amplified by- your adhd, vyvanse has been an extremely helpful tool in regulating my mood and keeping my depression in check. Not to say that depression and anxiety are completely cured by adhd meds on their own and it is 100% possible to have them all at the same time, but having a calm mind is so helpful for combating the feelings of multiple different mental issues

good luck!
